abi.allocation: none; caller-owned framebuffer; <3 KiB stack scratch

behaviors: blink episodes on a hashed 2.5-4.3 s schedule, 35 ms close / 100 ms open, occasional double blinks, right eye trailing 19 ms
saccade holds on a hashed 1.25 s grid with 56 ms flicks, smoothstep ease plus ~6% overshoot
anticipation: lids widen and brows lift ~75 ms before large gaze jumps
follow-through: head position tracks gaze with an 87 ms lag at 1/3 amplitude plus a damped 5 Hz wobble after large flicks
breathing sine at 0.25 Hz, halved while speaking; band-limited flicker channel
keyframe semantics always win: analyzer eye/look/brow values combine with, and bound, the idle motion

renderers.name: Oscillofluor Beam
renderers.language: XY vector CRT in the oscilloscope-music tradition
renderers.algorithm: one continuous parametric beam path retraced at ~83 Hz; the mouth segment is a synthesized voice waveform (three harmonics mixed from mouth_round/width/teeth, amplitude from mouth_open, raised-cosine envelope pinning the lip corners); stateless persistence redraws the last 120 ms of beam history from the sample clock with a two-layer P7 phosphor model (blue-white flash decaying into green afterglow), bilinear splats accumulated in the caller framebuffer itself (hi byte flash / lo byte glow) then colorized in one pass

renderers.name: Flip-Dot Cascade
renderers.algorithm: 40x30 disc panel refreshed every 100 ms; target image compared at the current and previous refresh tick (both derived statelessly from the clock), differing discs animate a 30 ms flip with row-scan latency (2.5 ms/row) plus per-dot mechanical scatter; mid-flip discs render as foreshortened ellipses via |cos| width with an edge-on slit and glint; per-dot wear tint, clack flash, idle border marquee

renderers.name: Chladni Voiceplate
renderers.language: cymatics: sand on a driven square plate
renderers.algorithm: separable standing-wave field cos(n pi u)cos(m pi v) - cos(m pi u)cos(n pi v) with per-axis cosine tables; the mouth bytes select the resonance pair ((1,3) rest, (3,5) open, (5,7) wide, (2,6) round, (7,9) sibilant) and blend by mouth_open; sand settles where |F| < threshold with hash-grain thinning and stray grains; eye clamps pull the field into lid-squashed concentric rings with sand-pile pupils; the mouth rim is a nodal attractor while its interior antinode blows clear; loud frames tighten lines and re-roll the grain hash at 31 Hz so the sand dances

renderers.name: Halftone Press
renderers.algorithm: analytic face luminance field printed through an AM halftone: black plate on an exact 45-degree screen (u=x+y, v=x-y), red spot-color plate at ~15 degrees via incremental integer DDA, deliberately misregistered by a slowly drifting offset; brush-weight ink outlines thicken toward the chin; highlights knock dots out; lowered brows or shouted frames grow manga emphasis lines outside the panel using a division-free diamond-angle estimate
renderers.mouth_kind: outlined ellipse with teeth band and red tongue plate

renderers.name: Wayang Lamp
renderers.language: shadow-puppet theatre on a cotton screen
renderers.algorithm: warm oil-lamp light field from a per-frame radial LUT with deterministic flame flicker; perforated leather silhouette with punched almond eyes (floating pupils), brow slits, nostrils and permanent hash-seeded filigree; the jaw is a hinged flap whose drop follows mouth_open, so speech literally pours lamp light through the mouth gap (with hanging teeth combs on sibilants); rod-puppet sway shear plus breathing bob from the shared rig

renderers.name: Ferro Pool
renderers.language: ferrofluid creature in a lit dish
renderers.algorithm: pool rim as radius-of-angle in Q4 (sub-pixel isqrt + integer atan2 only in the rim band): slow meniscus harmonics idle it, voice raises a Rosensweig spike crown (|sin|^4 lobes, count from mouth_width, height from energy, rounded vowels gather a central Taylor cone); interior grows the hexagonal Rosensweig lattice as three plane waves at 120 degrees whose contrast rides the voice; droplet eyes with gaze-tracking catchlight pupils sink into the pool on blink

renderers.name: Teletext Sextant
renderers.algorithm: authentic 40-column layout: header row with page number, service name and a live clock ticking from the sample counter; face painted into an 80x57 sixel image with the 8-color teletext palette, then each 2x3 cell forced through the real G1 constraint (one foreground color per cell, black background, six on/off blocks) so minority colors vanish as genuine attribute clash; head motion quantized to whole sixels; flash-attribute beacon at 0.75 Hz while speaking; test-card color bars in the bottom row

esp32s3_budget_note: Worst profile measures 0.166 ms/frame single-threaded on an M4 Max. Assuming a conservative 80x per-cycle disadvantage for a 240 MHz in-order LX7, the worst case extrapolates to ~13 ms/frame, inside the 33 ms budget for 30 fps; the median profile extrapolates to ~6 ms. All hot loops are int32 add/mul/shift with divisions confined to rim bands, per-frame setup, or small LUT builds, and total stack scratch stays under 3 KiB. This is an estimate, not a device measurement.

testing.native: make test: ABI contract, purity/determinism with interleaved renders, guard-band overflow canaries, every-pixel-written check via dual prefill, 120-case keyframe fuzz, frozen golden CRCs
testing.wasm: make wasm-check: emscripten build runs the same suite; the frozen native CRCs must match, proving byte-identical browser output
